The product, as built

Every token, icon and component the product actually renders, generated from its own stylesheets and components — not a drawing of them. The eight docs/*.html design documents say what was designed; this says what the code produces, and the gap between the two is drift. Hover, focus, active and disabled are derived from the product's own rules, so a control with no rule for a state draws the same as rest — that is the gap, not a rendering fault. Contract: docs/CONTROLS.md. Coverage: npm run states. Dead states: npm run gallery:audit.
